Yes, Isafi does support automatic bank syncing! It uses **Stripe Financial Connections** to connect your bank account and sync your transactions automatically. This feature is available on the **Pro plan**.

**To connect your bank account, follow these steps:**

1. Go to **Banking → Bank Accounts** in the top navigation
2. Click **"Connect Bank"** (blue button, top right)
3. Select your bank from the list of supported institutions
4. Follow the prompts to link your account securely
5. Once connected, your transactions will sync automatically
